Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings (target board pattern) on lower leaves, leading to yellowing and defoliation.
medicines: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP (e.g., Dithane M-45) at 2.0 - 2.5 g per liter of water.
For severe infections, apply Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole (e.g., Amistar Top) at 1.0 ml/L every 7-10 days.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_care: Prune infected bottom leaves, burn crop residues, and apply mulch to avoid soil-to-leaf fungal splashing.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Irregular dark water-soaked lesions on leaves and stems. White fungal mildew appears on leaf undersides in high humidity.
medicines: Apply Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (e.g., Ridomil Gold) at 2.0 g per liter of water.
Spray Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (Curzate M8) at 2.5 g/L during active spreading.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_care: Ensure effective field drainage, provide adequate plant spacing, and destroy severely blighted plants immediately.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Brown to black concentric necrotic spots primarily appearing on older lower foliage.
medicines: Apply Chlorothalonil 75% WP at 2 g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP at 2.5 g/L.
Potato___Early_blight.organic_care: Practice 3-year crop rotation and sanitize equipment after harvesting.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Rapidly expanding water-soaked dark lesions from leaf tips with white fungal growth in wet weather.
medicines: Preventive: Mancozeb 75% WP (2.5 g/L). Curative: Dimethomorph + Mancozeb (Acrobat MZ) at 2.5 g/L.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_care: Use certified disease-free seed tubers and hill up soil properly around growing tubers.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: No visible signs of bacterial, viral, or fungal infection. Foliage is vibrant green and vigorous.
medicines: No chemical fungicides or bactericides required.
Tomato___healthy.organic_care: Maintain regular balanced fertilization (NPK) and systematic irrigation scheduling.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Vigorous healthy foliage without pathological lesions.
Potato___healthy.organic_care: Ensure routine monitoring and prevent weed infestation.
